ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $ \triangle ABC \cong \triangle A'B'C'$, $ \angle BCB' = 30^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $ \angle ACA'$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\triangle ABC \cong \triangle A'B'C$,\\
it follows that $\angle ACB = \angle A'CB'$,\\
therefore $\angle ACB - \angle A'CB = \angle A'CB' - \angle A'CB$,\\
which means $\angle ACA' = \angle BCB' = 30^\circ$,\\
thus A meets the conditions stated in the problem.\\
Hence, the answer is: $\boxed{30^\circ}$.
